content: Executable docs verify steps actually work: Python doctest and sphinx.ext.doctest run interactive examples and compare actual vs expected output (setup/testcode/testoutput/cleanup directives, <BLANKLINE>). CLI invocations are harder than REPL snippets; sphinxcontrib-shtest tests shell commands in Sphinx with doctest syntax. Pattern: run code in REPL, copy verified fragments into docs so docs double as tests. Evidence = captured run output compared to documented output.
